notes.title: We’ve integrated Tobii Eye tracking technology into Coffin Dodgers!!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7854686/072e3e82e1579826a7605660c8c892e36c2d8d16.jpg[/img]

We have teamed up with Swedish Technology company Tobii and PC gaming giant Alienware to bring you a brand new update to our kart racing game Coffin Dodgers, exclusively on Steam for PC gamers. 

Tobii have developed a revolutionary new eye tracking technology that can now be found integrated into the new range of Alienware laptops.  

With the new Tobii update to Coffin Dodgers, we have introduced three new game features enabling the player to use their eyes to affect gameplay. Features include:
[list]
    [*]Tobii allows you to extend your field of vision by looking into corners before you turn into them – enabling you to see and avoid hidden threats lurking around the bend.
    [*]Use your eyesight to lock onto opponents with your weapons - select your enemies just by looking at them!
    [*]We’ve also enabled a HUD reveal component allowing the player to focus on the race. The HUD is only visible when the player wants it to be and made active by focusing your eyes to the area of the screen where the HUD would normally be.
[/list]

It feels like a whole new immersive and seamless layer of interactivity has been added to the game and makes it so much more fun.  

We want to encourage people to give it a go and let us know what you think. 

More information on Tobii can be found here: 
http://www.tobiigaming.com

More Info on Alienware’s new Tobii enabled laptops can be found here:
http://www.tobii.com/group/news-media/press-releases/2016/9/alienware-creates-worlds-first-intelligent-notebook-with-tobii-eye-tracking/
or at
http://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/productdetails/alienware-17-laptop?~ck=mn

notes.title: Coffin Dodgers Update 1.2.4
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.dropbox.com/s/9qa4m1h8lhwao8b/announcement_3newlaguages.png?raw=1[/img]

Hi guys,

We are very pleased to announce the latest Coffin Dodgers update includes localisation for three more languages:

• Chinese
• Japanese
• Korean

The full list of fixes/additions can be seen below:
 
• (Addition) Added Japanese, Chinese and Korean language modes.
• (Change) Updated joypad maps so more pads should be supported on more platforms.
• (Bug) Pad remapping fixed to stop getting stuck mapping a button
• (Bug) Fixed missing achievements.
• (Bug Linux/Steam OS) Some Linux users have had issues with split screen showing the same view for all players. Sometimes its related to hardware antialiasing. For this reason we default antialiasing off on Linux platforms at the start of a split screen race. (you can always turn it on again manually if you are desperate).
• (Bug) Fixed some small texture issues and lots of other small issues.
•(Improvement) Pause menus now hide options you cant use rather than just tinting them.
• (optimisations) New HUD layouts and code changes for better optimisation.

If you have any issues please let us know.

Hope you enjoy the game and thanks for the continued support.

Kind regards,

Milky Tea Studios

notes.title: Time Trial Competition
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.dropbox.com/s/j4zea1hgpyg0zwa/Timetrial.jpg?raw=1[/img]

[b]Beat the Reaper[/b]

Hi guys,

We are very pleased to announce the Coffin Dodgers Time Trial Competition -  Beat the Reaper.

The Grim Reaper (or in the case one of the dev team) has set a fiendishly fast time on a single track and it is up to you to try and beat it for your chance to win some great goodies.

To enter the competition you have to record a time in the Time Trial game mode on Village track 1 (Devil's Horseshoe). You can choose to play as any player (except for the Grim Reaper) and you can use any scooter, including any upgrades you like. Once you have recorded your time you must grab a screenshot and post it to @_MrGrimReaper twitter feed or post it as a screenshot on Steam.

To be a valid entry your time must be faster than 1 minute 42 seconds and your screenshot should be as the example below, showing character name and time.

[img]https://www.dropbox.com/s/3060q9hktkdimeg/Time_trial_end_screen.png?raw=1[/img]

The closing date for entries is the 4th January 2016. The winner will be announced on the 5th January 2016.

The winner will receive a signed Milky Tea Screen Print , x3 Coffin Dodgers Steam keys to share with friends and an Alienware goodie bag.

Good luck!

Milky Tea Studios

Happy gaming,

notes.title: Coffin Dodgers Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.dropbox.com/s/5uq1jcfxow39amm/New_Poster_Multiplayer_AI_1024x512.jpg?raw=1[/img]

Hi guys,

We are pleased to announce that the latest update includes the addition of AI players in the online multiplayer races. This is something that we noticed had been asked for a few times in the discussion groups and so we have worked hard to introduce this new feature.

In a network multiplayer 'Quick Race' AI will fill any race positions that are not taken by players. If you want to play without AI you can go into 'Custom Race' and turn AI off.

We have also introduced 11 new achievements based around online gameplay.

We really want to get more people playing online and so we hope that this new update will help somewhat towards this goal.

Here is the full list of updates:

• (Settings) Added Single Player Activate All Pads Option In Settings Menu • • Otherwise External Pad Mappers Will Wrongly Map Pads To Player Two
• (Changes) Added More Sheep
• (Multi Player) Added Bots To Multi Player Race (You Can Turn Them Off In Private Rooms)
• (Multi Player) Added More Achievements
• (Fix) Fixed floaty Keep Fit Gran
• (Fix) Improved Ragdoll collision In Farm Area Fences
 
Known Issues we are working on.

(Gameplay) Sometimes AI Can Get Stuck On Ramp In Farm 3
(Multi Player) Player Flags Dont Show For Other Players

Thanks for all your support and feedback as always guys and please do let us know if you come across any bugs or issues.

Kind Regards,

Milky Tea Studios

notes.title: Codger Kart Racing: Coffin Dodgers Released
notes.notes:
Lurking inside you is either a ghost or a skellington waiting to get out, we all know, but we’ll never live to find out which. What we rarely acknowledge is that an old person also waits within, one we try to hold back with our piercings and skateboarding and alcopops but can only contain for so long. Look at a baby’s face: we’re codgers from the day we’re born. May as well start practicing.

Coffin Dodgers [official site] is a combat kart racer with a bunch of our older friends zooming around a retirement village, and has now left Steam Early Access to properly launch.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Online Multiplayer is here!!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.dropbox.com/s/cl1nw26ykik7yr1/Online_Multiplayer_Image.jpg?raw=1[/img]

Hi guys, 

We are very pleased to announce the arrival of online multiplayer. We know the community have been excited about it for a while now and it is something we have been working hard to deliver.

We have decided to release this new game mode a little earlier than initially planned with the hope that we'll get lots of players in the game and the community will really get involved and give us lots of feedback and become part of the development process.

Please remember this is still an early access release and so you can expect a few bugs here and there. 

We have set up a dedicated discussion thread for all your thoughts and comments which will hopefully consolidate all feedback and allow us to respond and fix anything a lot quicker.

Despite it being a little rough around the edges, we really hope you enjoy the online multiplayer and can't wait to find out what you think.

Of course, as with all updates there are a number of additions/fixes to report. The full list can be found below:

• Added online multiplayer race mode
• All new pad code for better support
• New mid-range scooter added
• Fixed main menu items not highlighted
• Fixed booster retract after whack
• Fixed Lucy's cheer/win animation
• Oil is no longer set off by pick ups
• Optimisation on all tracks

Thanks for all the support so far guys and please do help us spread the word about Coffin Dodgers.

Happy gaming,

Milky Tea Studios

notes.title: Coffin Dodgers Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

It has been a while since we made our last announcement, way back in August in fact, and so we thought it was about time we gave you an update on what has been going on with Coffin Dodgers. 

It has been an exciting 6 months and time has flown by since we were fortunate enough to be Greenlit by the Steam Community back in July 2014. Being Greenlit showed us there was a market for the game and crucially it allowed us to interact with the Steam Community and get your thoughts on the initial concept. 

Since then we have taken the game demo to Gamescom in Cologne, where it got a great reception, and have been flat out developing the game further, adding new features and implementing all the feedback we could. 

We are now at the stage in which we want the public to play the game and are again seeking the involvement and collaboration of the gaming community. We will be making the game available on Early Access at the end of February and would love you to become part of the development process. 

The Early Access release will be available for a heavily discounted price as a little thank you from us for supporting the game from an early stage. We hope you will play the game, let us know what you like and don't like, what you'd change or add and generally help us make the game that you want to see.

We have set up a dedicated Twitter @_MrGrimReaper and so if you have any questions or comments you can contact us there directly or of course through the variety of avenues on Steam.

Thanks for all your support so far and we hope you will share this game with your friends and help spread the word about Coffin Dodgers.

Kindest Regards,

Milky Tea Studios
